issue.title: Test Gap: Verify there is no kernel panic when doing grep in pmon docker container

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the test gap

Recently, we found an issue when doing `grep` in the `pmon` container on Cisco 8800 chassis, for example,

```
admin@dut:~$ docker exec -it pmon bash
root@dut:/# grep -r "text" /sys/kernel/debug
grep: /sys/kernel/debug/ubifs/ubi0_0/dump_tnc: Invalid argument
grep: /sys/kernel/debug/ubifs/ubi0_0/dump_budg: Invalid argument
grep: /sys/kernel/debug/ubifs/ubi0_0/dump_lprops: Invalid argument
grep: /sys/kernel/debug/split_huge_pages: Invalid argument
...
grep: /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/instances/rasdaemon/per_cpu/cpu6/snapshot_raw: Resource temporarily unavailable
grep: /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/instances/rasdaemon/per_cpu/cpu6/trace_pipe_raw: Resource temporarily unavailable
grep: /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/instances/rasdaemon/per_cpu/cpu6/trace_pipe: Resource temporarily unavailable
```

Cisco fixed this issue by an image update that removes all the content of the `/sys/kernel/debug/` folder within the pmon container.

We should have a test that can verify such issues won't happen in the future on all platforms.

### Affected Area

Doing `grep` within pmon container

### Impact of missing tests and proposed tests

We might run into the same problem for other platforms when doing `grep` within pmon container

resolution.title: Disable debugfs on Nokia 7215 IXS-A1 and 7215-C1 devices
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
This prevents kernel panics when `grep -r traverses /sys/kernel/debug` is executed inside the pmon container, which is covered by the new sonic-mgmt test `test_pmon_grep_no_kernel_panic` in `test_pmon_grep_safe.py`.
Fixes [sonic-net/sonic-mgmt#18394](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/18394)

#####   Type of change

- [x] Platform-specific fix
- [ ] Bug fix (generic)
- [ ] New feature

#### How I did it
Use the existing platform boot-parameter mechanism (ONIE_PLATFORM_EXTRA_CMDLINE_LINUX -> U-Boot linuxargs on Marvell Prestera arm64) to pass `debugfs=off` to the kernel at boot. Updated `device/nokia/arm64-nokia_ixs7215_52xb-r0/installer.conf` and `device/nokia/arm64-nokia_ixs7215_c1xa-r0/installer.conf` by appending `debugfs=off`.

#### How to verify it

- Verified /sys/kernel/debug is not available
- Ran `docker exec pmon grep -r "PMON_GREP_SAFE_TEST" /sys/kernel/debug/` without kernel panic
- Ran `tests/platform_tests/test_pmon_grep_safe.py::test_pmon_grep_no_kernel_panic`
